# The Bet · FinWise

> Module 1 · Ignite a PLG Motion. The growth hypothesis and where you're betting, plus the growth-loop visualization.

## Growth hypothesis

FinWise's biggest growth problem is an inability to monetize activated users, evidenced by a trial-to-paid conversion rate stubbornly frozen at ~2% even when core feature engagement (like financial modeling) spikes, because a B2B financial tool meant to command enterprise-level contract values cannot be justified in a "single-player" vacuum. The true buying trigger and long-term retention hook rely on multiplayer collaboration—specifically, the business owner actively working with their accountant, bookkeeper, or partner inside the shared workspace.

_Working notes: I think FinWise's biggest problem is a failure in early user activation and long-term value delivery, causing trial users to drop off before converting (2% conversion) and paid users to churn rapidly (60% annual churn). Evidence: Only 2% of trial users convert to paid, signaling friction in reaching core value during the reverse trial.

60% of paid users churn within year one, proving the software fails to integrate into daily/weekly small-business workflows.

Increased paid acquisition spend is stalling, showing top-of-funnel volume cannot solve a bottom-of-funnel leak. Against the data: The specific data point strengthening this is the dismal 1.99% average trial-to-paid conversion rate, compounded by Pattern 3 showing that historical churn outpaces new paid conversions across the board._

_____

## The bet

the highest-leverage experiment I'd run first is injecting a seamless "Invite Your Accountant/Advisor" collaboration trigger immediately after a user completes a financial model, testing whether multiplayer trial workspaces yield a statistically significant lift in paid conversions compared to single-player workspaces.

**Not doing:** I am deliberately not running top-of-funnel acquisition campaigns or single-player UI onboarding optimizations. The trade-off is accepting a potential bottleneck in total trial volume and individual feature discovery in order to hyper-focus engineering resources on generating a smaller, but highly qualified, cohort of collaborative workspaces that actually cross the monetization finish line.

_____

## Growth loop

**Loop type:** Collaboration, Because FinWise is a B2B financial management tool, building features that encourage users to invite their bookkeeper, accountant, or business partner directly into the workspace naturally pulls in high-intent users. Since 98% of solo trial users are failing to see enough value to pay, a collaboration loop injects multiplayer utility into the product, which is highly effective at pushing B2B users over the monetization line.
